summary: Use config.toml while migrating older config.json files safely.
reason: Documentation and credential migration expect TOML, but the published runtime resolved and wrote JSON. Keep the older JSON files readable, preserve TOML settings when both formats exist, recover missing JSON credential fields, scrub old credential fields after the next auth save, and report an incomplete migration if scrub fails. Malformed active JSON must fail clearly.
validated_outcome: Offline tests cover coexisting TOML and JSON precedence, credential-field scrub, incomplete-save errors, and doctor warnings for old or unreadable JSON; Go tests, vet, build, skill verification, and diff check pass.
